name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Client Success Manager | Adoption, Health Scoring, Escalations & Business Reviews

Retained all but one of 15-20 partners at Birdeye, including agencies serving healthcare clients, and fed prioritized customer feedback to Product. Led a team of 20 (later 8) at Wix.
